answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in zephyr and mesa lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the kernel graph. Verification costs 2 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 1366 account sybil into a 2 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
